caption: The drawing depicts two views of a girl's outfit, rendered on a grayish-beige background. The main focus is a detailed front view of a dress ensemble displayed on a mannequin torso. The dress is light-colored, predominantly white or ivory, with elaborate floral lace patterns decorating the bodice, sleeves, skirt hem, and the lower parts of the pantalettes. The bodice features a square neckline with a border of lace, short puffed sleeves each trimmed with a lace ruffle, and a fitted waistband at the natural waist. The skirt is knee-length, partly overlaid with an apron or panel of lace, with a scalloped lace edge, and matching lace-trimmed pantalettes extend below the skirt, reaching mid-calf. To the upper right, a smaller, simplified rear view of the same dress is shown, displaying the back sash and the shape of the dress, as well as the pantalettes beneath. The composition uses white, light gray, and delicate black outlines to emphasize the lacework and garment contours, with no additional objects or background features present. The artist’s signature, “Jean Bazeel,” is in the lower left corner.
title: Child's Dress
